free_tier.stated: 2 GiB free storage per organization; Universal Packages up to 4 TiB per file.

retention.stated: | Hard 2 GiB per org; publishing is blocked at the cap until you delete packages or enable pay-go billing ($0.25-$2/GB/mo tiers)

egress.terms: Unmetered for restore (ADO has no egress meter).

tooling: az artifacts universal publish/download, nuget/npm/maven/python clients; Universal Packages are the only type that lets you push a multi-TiB blob
chaining: 2 GiB x unlimited orgs - but only 2 GiB per org and each org needs an Azure subscription to create. The interesting number is the 4 TiB per-file ceiling, which is moot at 2 GiB of pool.
limits_note: Hard 2 GiB per org; publishing is blocked at the cap until you delete packages or enable pay-go billing ($0.25-$2/GB/mo tiers). 500 MiB per file for NuGet/npm/Maven/Python/Cargo.
reliability_note: At the 2 GiB cap, 'you won't be able to publish new packages' - hard stop, no grace.

evidence.proved: 'Azure Artifacts provides 2 GiB of free storage per organization'; 'Universal Packages | 4 TiB'; 'When your organization reaches the 2 GiB free-tier storage limit, you won't be able to publish new packages'
'First 2 GiB free'; '0 - 2 GiB = Free; 2 - 10 GiB = $2 per GiB'

notes: 2 GiB free storage per organization; Universal Packages up to 4 TiB per file.

dead_end.why: 2 GiB free storage per organization; Universal Packages up to 4 TiB per file.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
